commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 700 /root/.ssh
umask 077
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PRIVKEY" > /root/.ssh/id_ed25519
ARCHIVE_HOST=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2 == "node1" {print $1; exit}')
ssh-keyscan -H "$ARCHIVE_HOST" > /root/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null
export ARCHIVE_HOST
python3 - <<'ANTRIEB_IMAP_CLIENT'
import hashlib
import imaplib
import os
import re
import ssl
import subprocess

host = os.environ['ARCHIVE_HOST']
password = [REDACTED]]]
    'ssh', '-o', 'BatchMode=yes', '-i', '/root/.ssh/id_ed25519',
    'root@' + host, 'cat /root/archive-demo.secret'
], text=True).strip()
context = ssl.create_default_context()
context.check_hostname = False
context.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
client = imaplib.IMAP4_SSL(host, 993, ssl_context=context)
print('server_welcome=' + client.welcome.decode())
print('login=' + client.login('archive', password)[0])
status, selected = client.select('INBOX', readonly=True)
print('select_status=%s message_count=%s' % (status, selected[0].decode()))
status, ids = client.search(None, 'ALL')
print('search_status=%s sequence_ids=%s' % (status, ids[0].decode()))
for seq in ids[0].split():
    status, data = client.fetch(seq, '(FLAGS BODY.PEEK[])')
    meta = data[0][0].decode(errors='replace')
    body = data[0][1]
    msgid = re.search(br'^Message-ID:\s*(.+)$', body, re.I | re.M).group(1).decode().strip()
    payload = body.split(b'\n\n', 1)[1].decode().strip()
    flags = re.search(r'FLAGS \(([^)]*)\)', meta).group(1)
    print('message seq=%s flags=(%s) message_id=%s body=%s sha256=%s' % (
        seq.decode(), flags, msgid, payload, hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()))
print('logout=' + client.logout()[0])
ANTRIEB_IMAP_CLIENT

ARCHIVE_HOST=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2 == "node1" {print $1; exit}')

python3 - <<'ANTRIEB_BASELINE'
import imaplib, os, re, ssl, subprocess
p = subprocess.check_output(['ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','-i','/root/.ssh/id_ed25519','root@'+os.environ['ARCHIVE_HOST'],'cat /root/archive-demo.secret'], text=True).strip()
c = ssl.create_default_context(); c.check_hostname=False; c.verify_mode=ssl.CERT_NONE
m = imaplib.IMAP4_SSL(os.environ['ARCHIVE_HOST'], 993, ssl_context=c)
print('login=' + m.login('archive',p)[0])
print('select=' + m.select('INBOX',readonly=True)[1][0].decode())
_, ids=m.search(None,'ALL')
for n in ids[0].split():
    _, d=m.fetch(n,'(FLAGS BODY.PEEK[])'); meta=d[0][0].decode(); body=d[0][1]
    mid=re.search(br'^Message-ID:\s*(.+?)\r?$',body,re.M|re.I).group(1).decode()
    payload=re.split(br'\r?\n\r?\n',body,1)[1].decode().strip()
    flags=re.search(r'FLAGS \(([^)]*)\)',meta).group(1)
    print('seq=%s flags=(%s) id=%s body=%s' % (n.decode(),flags,mid,payload))
m.logout()
ANTRIEB_BASELINE
